name: Weekday Rings
description: A month in weekday columns, each day a small ring towards a daily goal, with a bar per weekday showing its average.

props.name: data
props.description: One value per day of the month, the 1st first. New data refills the rings and bars.

props.name: goal
props.description: The daily goal. A day's ring sweeps value ÷ goal and closes when the goal is reached; it is also marked across each bar.

props.name: firstWeekday
props.description: Column of the 1st, counting from the first weekday (0 is Monday with the default names).

props.name: month
props.description: Name of the month, for tooltips and the summary.

props.name: weekdays
props.description: Seven short column names. Defaults to Mon to Sun.

props.name: weekdayNames
props.description: Seven long names for tooltips. Defaults to Monday to Sunday.

props.name: name
props.description: What is counted, for the tooltip and table.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the rings and bars.

props.name: format
props.description: Writes values in the tooltip, legend and table. Defaults to grouped whole numbers.

props.name: legend
props.description: Show a legend for the rings, the bars and the goal.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the chart shows, for screen readers. Generated when left out.

props.name: action
props.description: A control on the right of the header, such as a PeriodStepper from @/components/miyuki-ui/lib/chart for the month.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card.

props.name: caption
props.description: Muted text after the value, e.g. "total steps".

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Also accepts delta, note, footer and every other prop of a div.
